title: Asset
description: Schema for the MEDIATE Asset entity. An Asset represents a protected or monitored system component registered in the Service Manager registry. It includes asset type, operational status, risk level, associated Sentinel, last assessment timestamp, and registration timestamp.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be asset.

assetType.description: Property. Type or category of the protected asset.

operationalStatus.description: Property. Current operational status of the asset.

riskLevel.description: Property. Current risk level associated with the asset.

associatedSentinel.description: Relationship. Sentinel entity associated with this asset.

lastAssessmentTimestamp.description: Property. Date and time of the latest assessment associated with this asset.

registrationTimestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the asset was registered in the Service Manager registry.
